title: Press release The MPC meeting scheduled for 28 March 2024 has been cancelled

Home News & Publications News Press release The MPC meeting scheduled for 28 March 2024 has been cancelled Press release The MPC meeting scheduled for 28 March 2024 has been cancelled 20 Mar 2024 The Central Bank of Egypt decided to cancel the scheduled meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee on Thursday, March 28th 2024, in light of the sufficiency of the special meeting of the Committee on Wednesday, March 6th 2024.
